adaptations: version 1.0 -> 3.0; library included via xsl:include; UTF-16 sources normalized to UTF-8; otherwise unmodified from upstream; exclude-result-prefixes='math' added (engine namespace-leak workaround). The echoed acos values are displayed via format-number(..., '0.00000000000000'): the engine's last-ulp acos results differ across host platforms (Windows 1.315016439662327 vs Linux 1.3150164396623272 — .NET runtime pal difference), so the golden is pinned at 14 decimal places where both platforms agree (divergence 4, ATTRIBUTION.md).
